searchText: <@!301186049323958275> based on our conversations on 3788, would it make sense to update the current one to reflect the new design (pre-compile) or withdraw and submit a new one? What stage of the process is the current EIP in? If it is in Draft, then I have no problem with you completely gutting and rewriting it. If it is in Last Call I would be pretty strongly against that. Review is kind of in-between. What does this mean and how long can I expect to wait? I've got two PRs in this state. > Travis CI - Pull Request > Expected — Waiting for status to be reported > If it is in Draft, then I have no problem with you completely gutting and rewriting it. Cool ya its still draft If you think it is stuck, try closing and re-opening. Sometimes CI gets stuck and that is the first thing to try (turn it off and on again). I decided to close the request, delete the branch, and start afresh. Worked for one of them. Will try for the other, thanks. <@301186049323958275> sounds good but can you create an issue in the bot repo? I'm not available to do it right now so that I don't forget.
